title: Verify four selected Math Discovery CLR signatures directly from three immutable private NuGet archives
commitMessage: test: qualify private packaged Math Discovery CLR bindings

contribution.summary: Verify exact selected Math Discovery CLR signatures from immutable Composition, IR and Quantities private package DLLs, without project references or publishing.
contribution.value: Stage a source-free C# reflection audit that reads NUGET_LOCAL archives, validates archived and loaded DLL SHA-256 against existing RS167/RS146/RS137 published receipts, checks the package dependency closure, and compares four runtime MethodInfo signatures against source-pinned schema-2 fingerprints.
debtChanges: RS196 succeeded attempt 001 first-pass and established the distinction between source preview versions and private calendar-version packages.
This independent check loads only qualified existing net10.0 private binaries in memory and does not create or change NuGet archives, package references or public APIs.
Passing reflection would qualify these four CLR binding identities only; it does not grant broker permissions, AURA adoption, or complete M8-W01-C02.
contribution.nextAction: After durable RS197 success, qualify bounded actual method invocation from the same installed private package graph and reconcile the full Discovery completion criteria before any native lifecycle transition.
